column1: # Permissions the provider may list for a stranger from a corpus file that passes the default lint run
# (exit 0).  One line per entry, tab separated: class, name regex, actions regex, reason.  The regexes
# match the whole name and the whole actions string.  ${user.home} and ${java.io.tmpdir} in a name regex
# stand for the property value, quoted.  Derived from what the clean corpus files grant (PolicyLintCorpusTest).
# Every entry must be matched by a listed permission (no dead entries) and none may rate HIGH in the
# catalogue.  A listed permission that is neither here nor implies one of the cross-check questions
